after.RouteNotes: CB: route from GIS source — Route taken from the Oil and Gas Watch record for the Southeast Market Pipeline Project, which holds the Sabal Trail, Hillabee Expansion and Florida Southeast Connection routes as separate parts. This is the first part, 126.5 miles from the Central Florida Hub near Intercession City in Osceola County to the Martin Clean Energy Center near Indiantown in Martin County. The site grades the record medium and says it was georeferenced from Federal Energy Regulatory Commission filings from 2014. The start sits on the Sabal Trail route already in the routes repository, within about 50 meters. The line is about 203 km long, which matches the 126 miles on the sheet and the 126 miles in the 2014 Federal Energy Regulatory Commission application notice. The two later laterals, the Okeechobee Lateral and the Riviera Beach Lateral, are not part of this route.
